SHOT 09B | 04s to 08s | 4 seconds
85mm hand detail from south at rim height. His right hand returns, trembles against the lid, then lifts it. Frame the lid and fingers; the high bowl wall conceals the interior. He recoils a few centimeters, then steadies his wrist with his left hand. His rigid mask remains outside this detail.
SHOT 09C | 08s to 12s | 4 seconds
50mm chest-height medium view from south. Brief time compression: both source lids now rest beside their bowls. Using the single spoon, he transfers one small spoonful from A, then one from B into the central bowl. The material is pale and indistinct at this scale, without anatomical detail. The camera stays at rim height; the action reads as substitution and mixing.
SHOT 09D | 12s to 15s | 3 seconds
65mm close medium from the same side. He makes one reluctant stirring movement, sets the spoon down and closes the serving bowl with its lid. His hand stays on the lid while his shoulders fold. He fails to straighten before the cut.
END STATE AND EDIT

SOUND
Ventilation, held breath, lid scraping softly, two quiet spoon contacts, one stir and the lid settling. Keep the sound mundane and close, without wet amplified effects.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
